title: Numbers 1 to 5
short: Match the numbers 1 to 5 to groups of things.

blocks.html: Numbers can be written down. This is how we write them: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. The written 3 means three things.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Three apples go with the number 3.

blocks.html: A written number tells how many.

For the grown-up: Point out written numbers: on doors, clocks, buttons in the elevator and pages of a book. Write 1 to 5 on sticky notes and put the right number of blocks on each one. Stop while it is still fun. Then go and play the real-life version.

items: Try it at home: Find numbers on a walk: house numbers, signs.
Match number cards to piles of buttons.
Trace numbers in sand or flour.
